description: This file defines the InstallerController class, which extends an abstract controller and manages the pre-render process for an installation screen in the OrangeHRM application. It sets up a Vue component for the installation process and manages state related to the installation screen.

classes.name: InstallerController
classes.description: Controller managing the installer UI flow, responsible for rendering pre-installation screens and setting up the Vue component for the install process.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the installation screen by creating a Vue component and setting the current screen state.
